[h1] TABG [/h1]

Totally Accurate Battlegrounds is a very funny and simple game. The game convinces with its style, customization options, vehicles and with its many weapons and items. The graphics look appropriate and great. The menu is clear and very cool, the best ever. The weapons can be modified with a large number of attachments. The many different grenades in the game, which for example create black holes or rain of arrows, are very funny and unique. A very important point in this game are the halos, which give you various buffs and skills, but the reds and oranges are particularly strong. You can try everything on the shooting range before going into battle. The physics make the game a lot more fun than ordinary battle royales. The game feels amazingly good from the controls. Also, there is no unnecessary battlepass, which some people will like a lot (me too). There is so much that can be said about TABG, so I recommend simply giving it a try. It's easy to get in and understand everything very quickly. Since it's free from today, you should try the game, maybe even with your friends.

Long time Steam-er; first time reviewer...

  In the time since the Battle Royale revolution exploded last year, I've watched many a Let's Play of PUBG and Fortnite.
But after watching some of my favorite Youtubers play Totally Accurate Battlegrounds...
I KNEW I had to get this game...

   Although the developers had only intended TABG to be their annual April Fool's joke --in this case, an homage/parody of the BR genre-- I see why so many have seen past the joke and take this game to heart...
[list]
[*]Faster gameplay than PUBG and Fortnite
[*]Gorgeous graphics
[*]A unique spin on BR's signature circle; you have to see it to believe it!
[*]Wacky physics (as only a Totally Accurate game could!)
[*]Oh, and of course...
"Pressing "G" is...   'Gangsta!'" -jacksepticeye, 2018
[/list]

  Yes, the game is a work-in-progress, and it needs a little polishing, but Landfall did so much to set TABG apart from its inspirations, all the while staying true to BR's bottom line: Last one/squad standing...

I LOVE this game.

The only reason people dislike this game is because they are not chad enough to play it. This game is an absolute masterpiece and is without a doubt one of the best games you can own. The weapons are awesome as well and have a unique feel to them with some weapons being more normal like an AK and others being a literal balloon gun that float enemies into the air. And we can't forget about the attachments. The attachments in this game are beautiful as the game allows you to put any attachment on basically any weapon. Do you want to put a massive barrel onto a taser or glock and spin around shooting so that you look like a beyblade, well you can. And lets not forget the best weapon in the game, the frying pan, hands down the best weapon in this game. The core gameplay is absolutely perfect, the movement feels great and has a fun style to it allowing you to scale buildings and makes 1v1's very interesting and different each time. Finally, while I could ramble on for another century about how much I love this game, I'll end it with saying that if you either want to be a massive sweat or go completely monkey brain, you are going to find success either way.
